scripts.prisma:generate:app: PRISMA_BIN=$(which prisma || echo '../../node_modules/.bin/prisma'); if [ -f ../api/prisma/schema.prisma ]; then $PRISMA_BIN generate --schema=../api/prisma/schema.prisma; elif [ -f ../../prisma-schema/schema.prisma ]; then $PRISMA_BIN generate --schema=../../prisma-schema/schema.prisma; elif [ -f /app/apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma ]; then $PRISMA_BIN generate --schema=/app/apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma; else echo 'Prisma schema not found, skipping generation'; fi
